text:
maria: Heads up — Console is landing a change to routing policy telemetry this week. We'll emit a new header `x-rd-route-meta` with compact JSON about policy decisions (priority, version, fallback).
maria: This is mostly for Console dashboards so customers can correlate which policy routed a request, but SDKs should passthrough the header when present so we don't lose lineage.
sam: Quick q — do we expect clients to construct `x-rd-route-meta` or only forward from our internal proxy?
maria: only forward by default. But for on-prem / private deployments we want an opt-in way for clients to set a route hint. So SDKs should add an *optional* param `route_meta` on request APIs that serializes to the header when set.
alex: For TS/Go/Py: name suggestions? `routeMeta` in TS/Go, `route_meta` in Py? Keep it consistent with existing arg naming patterns.
ryan: Docs + changelog note: make it explicit that setting route_meta is a power-user feature and can affect routing costs / quotas. We should also add a Console toggle to redact route_meta from telemetry for customer privacy.
sam: Concern: if SDKs start sending this header, we could accidentally let apps override routing decisions. We need server-side validation and a feature flag + quota impact check.
maria: Agreed — server will ignore unsupported or malformed route_meta. We'll gate acceptance behind a team-level feature flag; only customers who opt in + signed contract can set it. Forwarding existing header is allowed always.
alex: Implementation plan for SDKs: add optional param on `client.request()` surface, deprecate nothing. Minimal change, examples:
```js
// TS
client.request({
  prompt: 'hello',
  routeMeta: { priority: 'low', policyVersion: 'v2' }
})
```
```py
# Py
client.request(prompt='hi', route_meta={'priority': 'low', 'policyVersion': 'v2'})
```
sam: Go team: watch out for JSON-in-header escaping and header length limits. We should recommend a compact stable encoding (no spaces, stable key order) and a max size of 2KB.
ryan: I'll add a small guide in quickstarts and a console checkbox for "include route metadata in telemetry". Also will draft a short email to customers in the opt-in cohort.
maria: Rollout idea: server accepts forwarded header right away for visibility (no routing change). For opt-in clients, we enable `can_set_route_meta` flag per account and then enable server-side policy usage in a canary region. We'll announce a 2-week opt-in window before any behavior change.
sam: Tests: add e2e to ensure header passthrough for hosted requests, unit for SDK serialization, and an integration test for header rejection when malformed.
alex: I'll open PRs: TS + Go (this week), Py follow-up (early next week). Ping me for pairing on header encoding.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: console/route-meta-feature-toggle -> canary 22:00 UTC tonight :rocket:
ryan: Thanks — I'll coordinate docs + release notes once PRs are up.
maria: Great. If no objections, we'll go ahead with the plan. :thumbsup:
sam: :+1:
alex: :shipit:
